text:
maya: Heads up: quarterly admin entitlement cleanup starts next week. Need to confirm approach for mapping KMS grants -> human owners before we trigger deprovisioning.

tom: We should join the KMS grants export with CloudTrail events to detect activity. If a grantee principal hasn't called Encrypt/Decrypt in 90 days mark as dormant.

rachel: Agreed. Also add a check for assumed-role sessions (sts:AssumeRole). Those often show up as `principalId` only; map them via assume-role events to recover the ARN.

sam: For owner attribution prefer (1) owner tag on IAM role, (2) maintainer in infra repo via git blame, (3) fallback to a security ops alias. Add confidence scores so reviewers can triage low-confidence items.

maya: Good. Can we enrich each evidence item with KMS DescribeKey (rotationEnabled, keyState, aliases)? Reviewers want to see that.

kms-bot: KMS enrichment job queued for 3276543210 window :gear:

tom: One more: exclude Cognito and product-user federated principals from admin sweep. Let's centralize ignore patterns in `security-config/admin-sweep-ignore.yaml`.

rachel: For remediation flow: do not auto-revoke. Instead show candidates in Console with one-click revoke that calls RevokeGrant and records previous GrantId in evidence bundle for rollback. Add a soft-mode to require two approvals for high-impact keys.

sam: I'll add unit tests for the fuzzy name matcher (strip env suffixes, numbers, hyphen variants). Also implement numeric confidence buckets: >=90 auto-safe, 70-89 notify owner, <70 manual triage.

maya: Plan: sam implements matcher + tests, tom wires joins & enrichment, rachel updates remediation UI/approval flow. Dry-run Wednesday, then schedule final on next Tuesday.

kms-bot: Export complete: 4,212 grants scanned, 342 candidates flagged, 47 unknown-owner items :white_check_mark:
